title: Microsoft Entra ID: identity-verified account recovery for users who lose all sign-in methods (Android, iOS, desktop)
summary: Hold: the profile API is presented as controlling which users can recover, but its documented request properties do not configure user-group scope. The recovery defaults, licensing and corrected Evaluation-versus-Production test guidance are supported; several portal paths stop short of their controls.

Use 'Entra ID > Account recovery > Settings (preview) > Actions after recovery > Issue Temporary Access Pass' for the UI path, and append to the existing note: 'Stale credential cleanup is in the same Actions after recovery section.' claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: ID verification profiles are configured at Verified ID > ID verification profiles > Profiles in the Entra admin center.
claims.quote: Create and manage profiles in Verified ID > ID verification profiles > Profiles. For provider selection, user groups, profile mode, and account-validation steps, follow Create an ID verification profile. Select Recovery as the profile purpose.
claims.fix: The route stops on the correct profile list. For creating a recovery profile, extend it to 'Verified ID > ID verification profiles > Profiles > Create profile > Profile purpose > Recovery > Profile mode > User group selection > Identity Verification Provider > Configure account validation', using the wizard steps at the already cited https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/verified-id/how-to-create-id-verification-profile. Keep the table and rollout guidance consistent.

claims.claim: POST /v1.0/identity/verifiedId/profiles creates a profile with issuer, claim-validation and usage configuration.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/identity/verifiedId/profiles ... verifiedIdProfileConfiguration ... Set of properties expressing the accepted issuer, claims binding, and credential type. ... verifiedIdUsageConfigurations

claims.claim: verifiedIdUsageConfigurations sets the profile purpose to recovery, onboarding or all.
claims.quote: verifiedIdUsageConfigurations ... Collection defining the usage purpose for the profile. The possible values are: recovery, onboarding, all, unknownFutureValue. Required.
claims.fix: The create reference lists these values, but https://learn.microsoft.com/graph/api/resources/verifiedidusageconfiguration?view=graph-rest-1.0 says 'Currently only recovery is supported.' Replace the purpose sentence with 'The request body property verifiedIdUsageConfigurations sets the purpose; use recovery for account recovery.' Cite that resource reference and do not imply onboarding and all are currently supported API scenarios.

claims.claim: The listed create-profile API controls who can recover by setting the profile's user-group scope.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Graph verifiedIdProfile create profiles user group include exclude assignment scope. Read Create verifiedIdProfile request properties and verifiedIdProfile/verifiedIdUsageConfiguration resources: no group targeting property or relationship; portal documentation configures groups.
claims.fix: Narrow controls[2].governs and its table label to 'Identity verification profile issuer, validation rules and usage purpose'. Keep POST /v1.0/identity/verifiedId/profiles, but add to the note: 'The request body uses verifiedIdProfileConfiguration for issuer and claim-validation configuration.
